description: `await f()` takes f's color: the promise's rejection rides the same color the sync channel does, so one mark covers the whole surface.

diagnostics.message: Awaiting `rejects()` escapes this `@nothrow` function: the body producing it was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try { await … } catch`, or make that producer non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
